subject: general
question: Which one of the following lines runs parallel to Arabian Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Konkan Railways.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **The Konkan Railways **lines runs parallel to Arabian Sea.
 
• The Konkan Railway is a railway operated by the Konkan Railway Corporation, with its headquarters at** CBD Belapur in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra**, India.
 
• The first passenger train ran on Konkan railway tracks on 20 March 1993, between** Udupi and Mangalore.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• About Indian Railways

 
 
• ​Founded - 16 April 1853
 
• Headquarters - New Delhi
 
• Parent organization - Government of India
 
• Indian Railways - largest rail network in Asia.
 
• The first railway on the Indian sub-continent - from Bombay to Thane
 
• Formal inauguration -16th April 1853.
 
• The first electric train in India - DECCAN QUEEN (1929, from Kalyan to Pune)
